purpose: City-specific registry/map source review and bounded safe route inspection for the WUP ranked settlement point (Huadu).
primaryPublisher: Guangzhou Municipal Planning and Natural Resources Bureau, Huadu Branch
registryBasis: The Huadu branch of the Guangzhou Planning and Natural Resources Bureau publishes city-specific real-estate registration service information, and Huadu’s public disclosure catalog lists registration and cadastral-information procedures. This establishes a city-specific registration institution, not an anonymous parcel-vector service.

officialSources.observation: Official Huadu branch report describes its district real-estate registration service and interdepartmental registration workflow.
Official Huadu natural-resources disclosure catalog includes real-estate registration and cadastral-information procedure categories.
Official Guangzhou Tianditu portal lists general map APIs and a cadastral-enquiry application; API/service use requires developer authorization. No cadastral enquiry was submitted.
